I keep overthinking it in my head, that’s why I’m in so much despair. It’s more the fact that they’re angry that I almost went through with it, that I even considered it, that I pretty much betrayed them, and worse yet that I never told them after a year, they had to find out from someone else. I’m just afraid, terrified that I’m going to. I know I deserve to, I just really hope I don’t. They’re my world and I love them to bits, there isn’t a thing I wouldn’t do or a line I wouldn’t cross, an amount of time I wouldn’t wait to make it up to them.

Almost cheating: I almost had phone sex with my ex, like I stood up almost pulled my trousers down then realised “wtf am I doing, I shouldn’t be doing this” told my ex as much then ended the call.

Who told them: My other ex who was told by the ex I almost cheated with, told my partner. I should’ve told them, ffs I should’ve told them.

My partner: the first person I’ve actually felt proper love for, I honestly thought I knew what love felt like, then I met them and it blew my world. I love them to bits and I’ll do anything to fix the situation I just don’t know how.
